answer: Sybil resistance uses stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond before its vote or answer counts, and weight follows the bond, never the headcount. An attacker launching a voyage of fake personas still pays real capital per identity, each needing a ledge of its own collateral. Detected fraud slashes that bond, so fake names must be constantly refinanced. Cultivating an orchard of sybils multiplies cost linearly while granting no extra influence.
